title: BIO-MIMIC X BSH K01442 published human cohort replication + independent orthogonal check

external_results.interpretation: No clear pathway signal in this cohort; NOT a direct BSH gene replication; negative finding retained

assumptions_and_limits: Different source data modalities, protocols and cohorts
Unstratified rank tests; demographics and batch effects not adjusted
Source plotted values have no matching participant IDs or gene counts
AUCs are post-hoc apparent class separation, not prospective predictive validation
Comparator genes are bile-acid-pathway members, not unrelated negative controls
No direct bacterial enzyme activity assay in humans
Downstream extracted CSVs reflect public spreadsheets parsed to markdown; original bytes not locally preserved
